title: Grateful Dead Live at Lakeland Civic Center on 1982-09-12
lineage: Cassette Master (Sony TC-K677ES) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard recording with heavy natural reverb captures a solid September 12 1982 show highlighted by a powerful Wheel entrance and a sweet Sugar Magnolia.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers all rate the release highly, praising both the musical performance and the unusually clean yet reverberant front‑of‑house mix.  The recording is noted for its crisp clarity despite a heavy natural reverb that gives the band a spacious, “bathroom‑like” ambience, while the show itself delivers strong moments such as the opening of "The Wheel" and an inspired stretch of "Sugar Magnolia."

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are positive (average 4.33★) and emphasize a great performance plus excellent, pristine recording quality with only stylistic reverb noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house Sennheiser mics positioned near the board produce a clean, crisp mix with heavy natural venue reverb; reviewers describe it as pristine, punchy and upfront despite the lush ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth flow with a memorable entrance into "The Wheel" and a nicely blended segment featuring Dew and Sugar Magnolia; overall pacing feels natural and engaging.
